standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme perfect objects correspond to finite complexes of finite projective modules and derived quasi-coherent objects to module complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the module representatives M^bullet and (M')^bullet.

standard_prerequisites.name: The internal Hom of the representatives is computed by the Hom complex of the module complexes, and maps on the open U are sections over U of the internal Hom
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns alpha into an element s of H^0(U, R SheafHom(E, E')).

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology classes on a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme are represented by maps from the Koszul complexes of powers of the functions cutting out the complement
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the map xi from the Koszul complex I^bullet(f_1^e, ..., f_r^e).

core_obligations: Set X = Spec(A) and U = union of D(f_i); represent E by a finite complex M^bullet of finite projective A-modules and E' by a complex (M')^bullet of A-modules (proof lines 3589-3593).
The Hom complex Hom_A(M^bullet, (M')^bullet) represents R SheafHom(E, E') by the cohomology lemma, and alpha is a section s of H^0(U, R SheafHom(E, E')) by the section lemma (proof lines 3594-3600).

Represent s by a map xi from the Koszul complex I^bullet(f_1^e, ..., f_r^e) via the representation proposition on opens; define E_1 as the object associated to the total complex of I^bullet tensor M^bullet, with E_1 -> E the map induced by the canonical Koszul map to A and E_1 -> E' induced by xi; on U the Koszul complex becomes acyclic so beta restricts to an isomorphism and alpha = gamma beta^{-1} (proof lines 3601-3611).
proof_roadmap: Represent E and E' by module complexes over A (proof lines 3589-3593).
Turn alpha into a section of the internal Hom over U (proof lines 3594-3600).
Represent the section by a Koszul complex and build E_1 as the tensor product (proof lines 3601-3611).
